name: Blackfathom Deeps via Dungeon Finder names Aku'mai as the objective and completes on his kill (#5614)
contract: #5614: in a Dungeon Finder run of Blackfathom Deeps the objective tracker read 'Defeat: Unknown' and killing Aku'mai did not count. The tracker names GetLFGBoss(), which the client resolves from the current LFG dungeon id (SMSG 0x66D) through DungeonEncounterExtra.dbc; row 226 (Aku'mai 4829) is the final encounter of dungeon 10 in both the client and server DBC, and instance_encounters 226 has lastEncounterDungeon 10. Expected: on entering, p1 receives 0x66D carrying 10, and crediting Aku'mai completes the dungeon so the Classic Random reward of the 15-25 bracket is paid.

steps.label: The group is assigned Blackfathom Deeps
DISCRIMINATING: the client is told its current LFG dungeon is 10 (SMSG 0x66D), the id DungeonEncounterExtra.dbc resolves to Aku'mai instead of 'Defeat: Unknown'
Aku'mai, final boss of Blackfathom Deeps, is credited
p1 is rewarded Classic Random 15-25 (1st) 24882: the boss kill completed the dungeon
p2 is rewarded Classic Random 15-25 (1st) 24882: the boss kill completed the dungeon
